summary: Frontend-only test of the SEO brief, run against the production build served by Apache at :8088 (/tmp/site has the same files as /app/frontend/build, which is newer than the source). Checks covered: raw HTML for 13 URLs, redirects, 404 page, sitemap/robots, hydration on all 14 routes, header/footer/mobile menu, the /for-travel-agencies sections, FAQ and form, /services, Home, the halal CTAs, guide cross-links and forbidden words. Everything passes except one item: between 1024px and about 1279px the desktop nav wraps onto 2 lines and 'Home' touches the logo.

ui_bugs.issue: The nav is 'hidden lg:flex gap-6 xl:gap-10', so it appears from 1024px. Between 1024px and about 1279px the 7 links plus the Agency Login button do not fit. 'About Us', 'Travel Guide', 'For Travel Agencies' and 'Contact Us' wrap onto 2 lines. 'Home' starts at the logo's right edge with 0px gap and visually overlaps the 'TOURS' logo text at 1024. The layout is clean at 1280px and above. Fix: add whitespace-nowrap to the nav links, and switch the desktop nav to xl:flex (and the hamburger and mobile nav to xl:hidden). Alternatively, reduce the gap/font at lg.

issues: The hamburger button has no data-testid (only aria-label 'Open menu'/'Close menu').

action_items: Fix the desktop nav wrapping between 1024 and 1279px (whitespace-nowrap plus an xl breakpoint for the desktop nav, or tighter spacing at lg). Then rebuild with prerender.

Optional: add 'AddDefaultCharset UTF-8' to htaccess.template. Apache sends 'Content-Type: text/html' with no charset. Browsers fall back to <meta charset=utf-8>, but non-browser clients (e.g. python requests) decode as latin-1 and show 'KrakÃ³w'.

Optional: unknown URLs return the 404 page with HTTP 200 (soft 404), which the noindex mitigates. To get a real 404 status, use 'ErrorDocument 404 /404.html' plus 'RewriteRule ^ - [R=404,L]' instead of the 'RewriteRule ^ 404.html [L]' rewrite.
Optional: add a data-testid to the hamburger button.
critical_code_review_comments: prerender.py snapshot() relies on string indices ('<div class="App">' and the exact floating-button class string) to insert Suspense markers. If those class names change, the build breaks with a ValueError. This is acceptable, but fragile.

The Web3Forms access_key is duplicated: it is hardcoded in both Contact.jsx and PartnerInquiryForm.jsx. Consider moving it into lib/links.js (as done with AGENCY_PORTAL_URL) to avoid drift. The values are currently identical.
The partner form fields all have required attributes and email type validation. An empty submit is blocked by the browser and no request is sent. The botcheck honeypot is present.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (26/26 static pytest checks pass; all browser checks pass except nav wrapping between 1024 and 1279px)

seed_data_creation: none. Partner/contact forms were not submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'cd /app/tests && python -m pytest test_seo_static.py -q -p no:cacheprovider' against Apache :8088 (decode with r.content.decode('utf-8'), since Apache sends no charset). Static results: 13 URLs each have 1 title (all 60 or fewer; agencies has 82), 1 description (155 or fewer; contact and christmas are exactly 154/155), the correct canonical, og:title, twitter:title and 1 H1, plus body text; JSON-LD parses. Redirects: /Home, /home, /Contact-us, /contact-us, /About, /about/, /Travel-Guide/Halal-Tourism, /index.html, /contact.html, /SERVICES and /For-Travel-Agencies/ all 301 to the canonical in one hop. /old-page serves 404.html (HTTP 200) with noindex and links to /, /services and /contact. The sitemap has the 13 canonical URLs; robots.txt references it. Browser: 0 pageerror/console errors (no #418) on all 14 routes; exactly 1 title, description, canonical and H1 after hydration; no duplicate og/twitter tags; client-side navigation updates the tags. Header items and the Agency Login href/target/rel are correct on desktop and mobile; no 'Register' text except 'Agency Login / Register'. Agencies page: all 9 sections in order, 4 steps, 5 FAQ questions (first is the fixed packages one), FAQPage and BreadcrumbList, main has 848 words, form fields required, access_key matches Contact. Services: agency line, no old B2B paragraph, exact Group Tours text, cards are H2. Home: agencies/services/contact links plus 4 guide links. Halal: CTA top at 18% and bottom at 81%, both with /contact and /services links; FAQ plus FAQPage (7 questions). All 6 guides and /travel-guide have body links to /services and /for-travel-agencies. No forbidden words in raw HTML or visible text.
